method.coverage: Every reachable engine commit after e9ced7e7a through adba86f43; git log subjects and changed paths classified, with source/document checks for current marketed capabilities.
method.limits: Not a line-by-line review of every historical diff. Reverts, experiments and tooling are included; commit count does not measure feature count, current activation or performance.
method.cross_area_counts: Multi-label; do not sum category counts as total commits.
